aiSummary: In October 2026, Windows led operating systems (combined) (desktop) in France at 77.69% (market share of tracked page views / usage). OS X ranked second at 10.12%, followed by macOS at 6.08%.

faqs.question: Which item leads operating systems (combined) (desktop) in France?

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for operating systems (combined) (desktop) in France?
